ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Politics and Popular Culture. This course will examine political content in popular culture and the often blurred line between the political and cultural spheres. Particular attention will be devoted to music and television, but the course also will address the political significance of other cultural forms such as film, art, comics, and sports. The course will assess politics in messaging and the possible substantive effects of those messages. Prerequisite: Admission to Political Science Honors Program or consent of department.
